test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On 27th October 2019, Dushyant Chautala took an oath as Deputy Chief Minister of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dushyant Chautala** took the oath as Deputy Chief Minister of Haryana on **27th October 2019**.
 
• He is the leader of the **Jannayak Janta Party (JJP)**, a regional political party in Haryana.
 
• The oath ceremony was conducted following the formation of a coalition government between the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** and JJP in Haryana after the 2019 assembly elections.
 
• Manohar Lal Khattar, from the BJP, was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Haryana for his second term on the same day.
 
• Dushyant Chautala is the grandson of former Haryana Chief Minister **Om Prakash Chautala** and represents the younger leadership in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Haryana's Political Landscape**

 
 
• Haryana has a unicameral legislature with 90 members in the Legislative Assembly.
 
• The state has been historically dominated by regional parties and leaders, especially the Indian National Lok Dal (INLD) and its offshoot, JJP.
 
• The BJP emerged as a significant political force in Haryana in recent years, forming the government in 2014 and 2019.
 
 
 
• **Deputy Chief Minister Role**
 
 
• The Deputy Chief Minister assists the Chief Minister in governance and administration.
 
• In coalition governments, the Deputy Chief Minister often represents the interests of the coalition partner.
 
• The position is not mandatory, but it is created when deemed politically necessary.
 
 
 
• **2019 Haryana Assembly Elections**
 
 
• The elections were held on **21st October 2019**, and the results were declared on **24th October 2019**.
 
• No party secured an absolute majority; BJP won 40 seats, JJP won 10 seats, and the remaining seats were won by INC and independents.
 
• A coalition government was formed between BJP and JJP, with Dushyant Chautala becoming the Deputy CM.
 
 
 
• **Haryana State Overview**
 
 
• Haryana was carved out of Punjab on **1st November 1966**.
 
• It is known for its agricultural contributions, especially in wheat and rice production.
 
• Chandigarh serves as the shared capital of Haryana and Punjab.
 
• Haryana has a significant role in India's sports and defense sectors, producing many national-level athletes and soldiers.
